subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1043/26 NOTAMR U0644/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/E/000/999/5535N03716E999 A) UUUU  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2608140716  C) 2611142359 EST  E) AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF THE REPUBLIC OF SLOVENIA STIPULATING THAT ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED
AIRCRAFT AND AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR
LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS
HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY
THE SLOVENIAN AIRSPACE, EXCEPT FOR HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS,
SAR FLIGHTS AND LEASED AIRCRAFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS WITH
PERMISSION OF THE MINISTRY OF INFRASTRUCTURE, AND IN CASE OF
EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, AS PER AIP SUP 003/25,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN SLOVENIA, AS WELL AS AIRCRAFT OWNED,
CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM SLOVENIA,
AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY
THE SLOVENIAN AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY
THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR AIRCRAFT IN
EMERGENCY SITUATION, HUMANITARIAN AND MEDICAL FLIGHTS, AS WELL
AS CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS GRANTED
BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY END PART 1 OF 2
U1043/26 NOTAMR U0644/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/E/000/999/5535N03716E999 A) UUUU  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2608140716  C) 2611142359 EST  E) OR THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN
AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE. END PART 2 OF 2
